cancelEvent.title: Cancel {{event}}?
cancelEvent.body: Cancelling can't be undone. Here is what happens:
cancelEvent.point1: Every ticket is cancelled. Paid tickets are refunded to the buyer's original payment method.
cancelEvent.point2: Everyone with a ticket or RSVP gets an email and a notification.
cancelEvent.point3: The event's earnings are held to pay for the refunds.
cancelEvent.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the venue closed for repairs.
cancelEvent.failed: The event could not be cancelled. Please try again.
cancelEvent.doneBody: {{refunded}} refunded now, {{manual}} refunds processed by Tikèm, {{notified}} people told.

errors.cancel_balance_unavailable: We could not check this event's payouts right now. Please try again, or contact support.
errors.cancel_ledger_stamp_failed: The event was cancelled, but recording it failed. Please try cancelling again.
